entries.name: Air quality now
entries.from: NILU, the Norwegian air research institute
entries.gives: The latest fine-dust reading for a Norwegian town and how the air is rated, from low to very high.

entries.name: Avalanche danger today
entries.from: The Norwegian Water Resources and Energy Directorate, who run Varsom
entries.gives: Today's avalanche danger level for a Norwegian mountain region, from 1 low to 5 very high, with the forecaster's headline.

entries.name: Bikes at my station
entries.gives: How many city bikes and free docks a Bergen Bysykkel station has right now.

entries.name: Bikes at my Oslo station
entries.gives: How many city bikes and free docks an Oslo Bysykkel station has right now.

entries.name: A dad joke
entries.example: Why did the scarecrow win an award? He was outstanding in his field.
entries.gives: A new joke every hour, for the whole family.

entries.name: The biggest earthquake this week
entries.gives: The strongest significant earthquake of the past seven days, and where it struck.

entries.name: Exchange rate
entries.from: Frankfurter, which relays the European Central Bank
entries.gives: What one unit of a currency costs in another, from the European Central Bank's daily rates.

entries.name: A person on GitHub
entries.gives: How many follow a GitHub account, and how many public repositories it has.

entries.name: Latest release of a project
entries.gives: The newest release of a project on GitHub, and when it came out.

entries.name: A repository on GitHub
entries.gives: How many stars a repository has, how many issues are open, and when it was last pushed to.

entries.name: GitHub
entries.gives: Anything public on GitHub: a person, a project, its releases, its issues.

entries.name: Norwegian power prices
entries.gives: The hourly power price for each of the five Norwegian price areas, today and tomorrow after 13:00.

entries.name: The Norwegian weather service
entries.gives: Forecasts, nowcasts, sunrise and moon times, air quality, and weather warnings for any place, from the institute behind Yr.

entries.name: The moon tonight
entries.from: The Norwegian Meteorological Institute, who also make Yr
entries.gives: Where the moon is in its cycle where you are, and when it rises.

entries.name: Public holidays
entries.example: Name and date of each holiday
entries.gives: The public holidays of a hundred countries, this year and next.

entries.name: The next public holiday
entries.gives: The name and date of the next public holiday in a country.

entries.name: Norges Bank's rate
entries.gives: What one unit of a currency costs in kroner, at the central bank's daily rate.

entries.name: Norges Bank's exchange rates
entries.gives: Every exchange rate the central bank publishes, per day, in the SDMX form.

entries.name: Downloads of a package
entries.gives: How many times a JavaScript package was downloaded in the last week.

entries.name: Power price now
entries.from: Hva koster strømmen, which relays Nord Pool's day-ahead prices
entries.gives: The price of electricity this hour in your part of Norway, in kroner per kilowatt hour.

entries.name: Latest version of a Python package
entries.gives: The newest version of a package on the Python package index.

entries.name: Rain in the next hour
entries.from: The Norwegian Meteorological Institute, who also make Yr
entries.gives: How much rain is expected where you are in the coming hour, and how hard it falls right now.

entries.name: Where the space station is
entries.gives: The International Space Station's position over the Earth right now, and how fast it is going.

entries.name: Sunrise and sunset
entries.gives: When the sun rises and sets where you are today, and how long the day is.

entries.name: City bikes in Norway
entries.example: Bikes and docks at any station
entries.from: Urban Sharing, who run the Bysykkel systems
entries.gives: Every station of Bergen, Oslo, and Trondheim Bysykkel, with its bikes and docks right now.

entries.name: Earthquakes from the USGS
entries.example: Magnitude, place, and time of each quake
entries.gives: Every earthquake of the past hour, day, week, or month, as the survey records them.

entries.name: Weather right now
entries.from: The Norwegian Meteorological Institute, who also make Yr
entries.gives: The temperature and wind where you are, from the Norwegian weather service's forecast for this hour.

entries.name: Weather this time tomorrow
entries.from: The Norwegian Meteorological Institute, who also make Yr
entries.gives: The temperature and wind where you are, twenty-four hours from now.
